messages:
marco: Quick sync 10am PT 10m thread: were running a mini-burst nurture around the benchmark blog + webinar. Need timing, cohorts, and a short reminder flow. Draft plan: https://app.redwood.com/campaigns/mini-burst-apr2026

ivy: Love it. Objectives: 1) drive signups to webinar 2) capture trialers for the 7-day onboarding drip 3) feed high-intent to SDR queue.

rachel: Proposed cohorts: warm_trial_7d, recent_signups_14d, inactive_90d. Also create a high_intent segment (clicked_cta_or_registered) for the 1-hour reminder.

jay: For subject testing lets do a 15% holdout with 3 variants: value-lead, benchmark-statement, and social-proof. Keep the rest 85% optimized for winner after 6 hours.

marco: Send windows: NA (09:30 PT), EMEA (10:30 BST local), APAC (09:30 SGT local). For deliverability we should cap ramp 300/min per region first hour.

lia: Copy note 1: warm cohort gets product-focused headline; cold gets thought-leadership tone. I uploaded HTML + text fallbacks: https://cdn.redwood.com/mini-burst/v2

jay: UTMs: utm_campaign=mini_burst_apr2026&utm_source=news&utm_medium=email&utm_term=benchmark. Add a query param to flag cohort for downstream attribution: cohort={segment}.

deliverability-bot: FYI 1 automatic suppression check will run during staging. Known suppressed domains: examplecorp.com, bannedlist.net. If bounce rate rises above 4% sends will be paused.

ivy: Can ops run a seeded send to the internal list and a warm-only preview? Need inbox checks across Gmail, Apple, Outlook.

marco: Ops @jay can you schedule seeded sends and mock inbox sweep? Also blocker: legal asked for short privacy blurb in footer for EU recipients. Lia please add.

jay: Scheduled seeded sends for 2026-04-14 16:00 UTC to @marco @ivy @rachel @lia. Throttling set to 300/min with retry logic. Send script snippet:

```
regions = ["NA","EMEA","APAC"]
throttle = 300
holdout = 0.15
```

anchoring first wave to April 15 NA, April 16 APAC roll. Cold drip starts April 20 with 3-touch cadence (0, 3, 10 days).

rachel: Tracking: set dashboard tiles for opens, clicks, registrations, spam complaints. Alert if spam complaints >0.08% in 60m. Also capture signup source and ad-hoc eval prompts used.

lia: Reminder on compliance: EU recipients require explicit consent for marketing; exclude gdpr_opt_out=true. I added language in footer and uploaded final legal snippet.

marco: Plan for micro-surge: send 1-hour reminder to high_intent only, short subject line and single CTA to join. No attachments, plain text preferred.

ivy: For the A/B winner flow, auto-swap variant after 6 hours if statistically significant (p<0.05) using the 85% population. Well need a script to pivot and re-send remainder with winner.

jay: I can wire that into the console rollout. Will create a canary job: evaluate after 6h, threshold metric = click_rate. If winner found, update template and pause holdout.

deliverability-bot: Reminder 1 warm cohort rate limit set. Any change to from-address requires fresh seed test.

marco: OK final checklist: segments created, HTML + text ok, seeded sends passed, legal blurb in, UTMs set, dashboard tiles live. Who's owner for post-send summary?

rachel: Ill own post-send summary and first 24h analysis. Will post snapshot in this thread and on the campaign dashboard.

ivy: Booking 30-min debrief 24h after launch. Adding ops + growth + legal.

marco: Thanks team. Will drop final console schedule link once live. Ping here for any urgent blocks. :rocket:
